items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Antonette was a lady who comes in the place, and she dressed, beautiful, you buy champagne or whatever and she get a certain percentage off each bottle.

ctx.x: Now in the meantime, I'm hanging out with the Arabs, not Arabs, but Egyptians, then I became (inaudible) Egyptians. I was learning to speak, Mohammed passions; that was big and big and Chitte son was still running around, so one night Chitte son said come with me, I know a place where all the pretty women in the world are, and I said, well, Chitte son you didn't come down here with no women, I got mine over there. He said, man, will you please come with me. I'm going to a Greek carabet.

Now all the girls in there were German girls, very pretty girls and we sit in the booth awhile, drinking and they was -- Antonette was a lady who comes in the place, and she dressed, beautiful, you buy champagne or whatever and she
get a certain percentage off each bottle.
